name_en: Saitama no Udon — a family of local wheat noodle styles across the prefecture
summary_ja: 小麦生産量全国有数の埼玉で育った、うどんの総称。北東部はコシの強い手打ち麺、西部は濃いつけ汁、川沿いは幅広麺と地域色が豊かで、20種類以上のご当地うどんがある。
summary_en: An umbrella term for the wheat noodle traditions of Saitama, a leading wheat-growing prefecture. Firm hand-cut noodles in the northeast, strong dipping broth in the west, wide noodles along the rivers — more than twenty local styles exist.
source_title: 埼玉のうどん｜うちの郷土料理｜農林水産省
